title: The current profile is not visible in the profile editor
symptom: In the profile editor (and even after touching the name of the active profile on the main screen) I can't select the profile that is currently active. I don't see any of the two newly created local profiles today (manually via mobile phone).
cause: This seems to be caused by synchronization with NS (different profiles received from NS during editing).
fix: Review all profiles to be without error, do small change and save .... then you should see the same profiles in NS.
